title: Mexican Skillet with Buratta
description: A flavorful Mexican skillet dish featuring juicy chicken, Peruvian potatoes, and creamy burrata cheese.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook for 5-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the diced potatoes to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until they start to brown.
Add the cumin, chili powder, salt, and pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Return the chicken to the skillet and stir to coat with the spice mixture.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 5 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender.
Stir in the burrata cheese until melted and well combined.
Serve the skillet hot, garnished with chopped cilantro.
